title: Derived done display for mixed done+canceled parents
summary: Treat parent entities with only done/canceled children as done in the derived display layer.
description: Current state: planner canonical status derivation in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts already treats mixed done+canceled children as done because derivePhaseStatus() and deriveFeatureStatus() ignore canceled/rejected children when computing meaningful progress (see the derivePhaseStatus/deriveFeatureStatus block around lines 1914-1968). However the parent presentation layer in packages/plan-core/src/display-status.ts still maps any mixed terminal set to the parent-only display status `closed` (documented at line 109 and returned by deriveParentDisplay() near line 162). This makes phases/features with children {done,canceled} appear closed even though the positive completed outcome should be surfaced as done. Goals: adjust the derived display logic so parents whose terminal children are only done+canceled derive/display as done, while preserving current behavior for all-canceled => canceled, all-rejected => rejected, mixed canceled+rejected => closed, and any mixed terminal set containing rejected with done/canceled only if product rules still want closed. Update the relevant plan-core tests and any Web UI/API expectations that assert `closed` for done+canceled parents. Preserve harness-agnostic behavior in plan-core and avoid changing canonical persisted statuses or sort behavior.
dependencies: P089(F020)/T352 — complete the approved planner-skill and handoff-enforcement sequence before this display-layer task.

acceptedDecisions.title: Show status-log motivations in Status history
acceptedDecisions.decision: Extend the existing Web UI Status history accordion with a Motivation column populated from each statusLog entry description, using an em dash when no motivation exists.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: The planner already records transition motivations in statusLog.description, but the existing accordion discarded that field and exposed only date/from/to, making agent-entered operational reasons invisible to the human supervisor.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Update packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-history-accordion.tsx without creating a new history surface. Preserve inferred transition behavior, responsive accessibility, and existing task/phase/feature usage; add focused component coverage.

tasks.title: Adjust parent display derivation so done+canceled rolls up to done
tasks.description:
Investigate and correct the parent display-status derivation for features and phases whose children are terminal with a positive-completion mix. Current implementation: packages/plan-core/src/display-status.ts documents `closed` for mixed terminal outcomes and deriveParentDisplay() returns `closed` whenever every child is terminal but not all done/canceled/rejected individually; this currently includes the common {done,canceled} case. Canonical status derivation in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts already treats done+canceled as done because canceled/rejected are excluded from meaningful child status sets, so the bug is specifically in the display layer rather than persisted workflow status. Implement the product rule that a parent with children containing only done and canceled should display/derive as done, not closed. Preserve the existing outcomes for all-canceled => canceled, all-rejected => rejected, and mixed canceled+rejected => closed unless investigation shows another rule is required. Update plan-core tests for display-status and any downstream tests or badges that expect the old closed label. Verification should include targeted unit coverage for phase/feature parent rollups and a check that no canonical schema/status persistence behavior regresses.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented the display-layer correction in packages/plan-core/src/display-status.ts: terminal parent children containing only done and canceled now derive displayStatus=done when at least one child is done. Preserved all-canceled=canceled, all-rejected=rejected, done+rejected=closed, and canceled+rejected=closed; canonical persisted workflow derivation and sorting were not changed. Updated packages/plan-core/test/display-status.test.mjs and plan-store-display.test.mjs with truth-table and PlanStore phase-rollup coverage. Also implemented the user-approved Status history enhancement in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-history-accordion.tsx: recorded statusLog.description is retained as the Motivation column, empty and inferred transitions display an em dash, and the semantic table is horizontally contained for narrow viewports. Added packages/plan-web-ui/test/status-history-accordion.test.tsx. Verification: targeted core tests 37/37; focused UI tests 2/2; pnpm build; pnpm check; pnpm test:coverage with 504/504 Node and 84/84 Web UI tests, FINAL coverage 86.44% lines / 73.96% branches / 81.40% functions; pnpm plugins:check; git diff --check; full isolated real-server Playwright 34/34 across desktop and 390px mobile. Rebuilt Web UI bundles were copied to plan-server and pi-adapter. No commit or push performed; no remaining work identified.
